manuscript_title: AGG có mang lại lợi ích đo được không? Đánh giá thực nghiệm theo các giai đoạn phát triển Adaptive Goal Graph trong Runalith
data_policy: Numbers in tables and figures are summarized from identified project artifacts. No synthetic trial rows are invented in this bundle. Any aggregation/transcription is stated below.

primary_artifacts.verification: PASS_INTEGRITY_ONLY_NOT_ACCEPTANCE; CURRENT_SOURCE_HASHES_MATCH; 28 task templates, 7 family clusters, 140 graph instances, 700 records; zero errors and zero warnings.
limitations: Frozen synthetic development/regression catalog, no owner-approved real-world holdout
80 limit applies to successor-expansion counter, not total computation
Evidence coverage does not prove claim truth; evidenceClaimsVerifiedRate is zero

primary_artifacts.verification: The stored verification report says the paired benchmark was replayed and paired metrics rederived; acceptance still required.

limitations: Membership does not establish causal savings

current_operational_boundary: The research does not claim formal acceptance or production readiness. Source documentation reports PARTIAL_NOT_ACCEPTED, readiness BLOCKED, and execution gate CLOSED.

excluded_artifacts.phase: Historical local LLM pilot (excluded from quantitative inference)
excluded_artifacts.exclusion_reason: Excluded from manuscript tables and figures because the stored runtime source identity cannot be matched to current source and the comparison mixes prompted model inference with deterministic search over a supplied graph. No outcome or latency values from this artifact are used in the paper.

chart_reproduction.method: Figures are derived from the bundled, disclosed summary/per-case CSVs. No trial rows are simulated, no external-paper results are included in these figures, and the historic local-LLM pilot is excluded.
